_comment: District 3 (GDD §4.1; opens at suburbs FULL per district_park.tres powered_by). Threat tier 3 (crawler + hunter + shadow per scripts/enemies/enemy_pool.gd): teaches noise discipline — hunter hunts running sound (park_note_03). Canon anchors: blueprint_flashlight_battery is this district's blueprint (district_loot.gd BLUEPRINTS), doc_streetlight_manifesto = the Keeper's manifesto (documents_catalog), keeper's shed = grid-crew cache drop from park_note_03. Repair-part guarantee mirrors district_loot.gd REPAIR_PARTS (2x cable/fuse/transistor). All item ids verified against data/items/*.tres (41 ids, 2026-09).

Guarantee: fuse for STREETS, hidden under the chess pavilion boards.

rules: R1: In DARK, fixed_spawns alone must cover the repair chain (>=2 cable, >=2 fuse, >=2 transistor; shed key obtainable without lockpick).
R2: Rolled loot never includes stage-gated items early: table lookup uses the CURRENT DistrictData.Stage only.
R3: Fixed spawns are one-time per save; rolls are per-container with container_modifiers on qty.
R4: No firearms in park (tier 3 stealth district; molotov/firework/noise_bomb remain the ceiling). Serum first appears in STREETS rolls.
R5: Noise economy: alley/grove containers (trash_bin, boat_bin) sit in hunter lanes — reward maps to running-noise risk; open-lawn caches (cache_bench) are safer but poorer.
R6: Keeper's shed caches (blueprint, transistors) must not roll empty: the shed is a scripted cache drop, not RNG.
